keyPoints: Bhojan ke mukhya ghatak: carbohydrate, protein, vasa (fat), vitamin, khanij lavan (minerals), paani aur resha (fibre).
Carbohydrate (roti, chawal, aalu) sharir ko urja deta hai.
Protein (dal, doodh, anda) sharir ki marammat aur vriddhi ke liye zaroori hai.
Vasa (ghee, tel) urja ka bhandar hai, lekin seemit matra me lena chahiye.
Vitamin aur khanij lavan bimariyon se raksha karte hain; hari sabzi aur phal me bharpur milte hain.
Paani sharir ka lagbhag 70% hissa hai; resha (fibre) pachan me madad karta hai.
Santulit aahar ka matlab hai sahi matra me sabhi ghatak lena.
subject: Science
title: Bhojan ke Ghatak
